title: Character reference 'would_stand_again' has no 'no' option while the landlord/employer equivalents do
evidence:
id: "would_stand_again",
      control: Choice([
        #("yes", form_copy.opt_yes),
        #("unsure", form_copy.opt_unsure),
        #("prefer_not_to_say", form_copy.opt_prefer_not_to_say),
      ]),
---vs---
      id: "would_rent_again",
      control: Choice([
        #("yes", form_copy.opt_yes),
        #("no", form_copy.opt_no),
        #("unsure", form_copy.opt_unsure),
        #("prefer_not_to_say", form_copy.opt_prefer_not_to_say),
      ]),
---vs---
      id: "would_rehire",
      control: Choice([
        #("yes", form_copy.opt_yes),
        #("no", form_copy.opt_no),
        #("unsure", form_copy.opt_unsure),
        #("prefer_not_to_say", form_copy.opt_prefer_not_to_say),
      ]),
detail: A character referee who would not vouch again has no honest answer: only unsure or prefer_not_to_say. Both sibling questions (would_rent_again, would_rehire) include a 'no' wire option, so the asymmetry is likely an omission.
recommended_fix: Add #("no", form_copy.opt_no) to would_stand_again's Choice list to mirror would_rent_again and would_rehire, or document why character refs cannot decline.

title: Wrong-person URL is generated but absent from the documented route family and swallowed by the catch-all
detail: The Identity control's 'No' link targets /reference/:token/wrong-person, but that route is neither listed in this file's route family nor handled here; the catch-all renders the not-found page for any deeper GET not registered elsewhere.
recommended_fix: Register /reference/:token/wrong-person in the router (or this module) and add it to the header route family so the Identity 'No' link doesn't fall into handle_unknown_path.

title: month_year accepts unpadded months, breaking the zero-padded ordering assumption in validate_month_year
detail: Only the year's length is checked, so "2024-1" passes validation. The from<=to comparison then mis-orders mixed-padding values ("2024-1" > "2024-02" lexically), wrongly rejecting valid periods and storing non-canonical values shown raw in summaries.
recommended_fix: Also require string.length(month_str) == 2 (or normalize to zero-padded YYYY-MM before storing) so stored values satisfy the sort invariant the comparison and copy rely on.
